_about: SYLPH S15: its dials are painted into one texture (gauage, 512 px: the rev counter to 9,000 rpm in the middle, the speedometer to 180 km/h on the left, the fuel and water temperature on the right, the boost gauge in its pod on the dash top beside the windscreen pillar, -700 mmHg to +1 kg/cm2), and their needles are modelled: thin parts of the red trim's material (red, shared with the cabin's red bits: only parts under 5 cm count as needles). Each needle turns about its dial's middle (measured from its painted ticks: the rev counter's 0-2,000 rpm closer spaced, the speedometer's 0-20 km/h too) along its marks; the boost needle reads the turbo's boost (a vacuum at idle and off the throttle). The rev counter's small LCD (beside its clock buttons) is the clock, the speedometer's the trip meter. Hubs: metres from the steering wheel's centre (the model's axes: x right, y up, z back); axis: each dial's face; marks: [reading, degrees turned from the model's pose, clockwise].
